title: No upper-bound validation on pipe_tiers cost — pathological ladder values can overflow i32 dist accumulation in routing_rebuild
evidence:
dist := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator)    // dist-to-dst per node slot (cost units)
  summary: Add an upper-bound validation for pipe_tiers cost (e.g. <= 1e6) to make dist-accumulation overflow impossible in routing_rebuild.
  evidence: catalog validation only enforces cost >= 1 (the ruling's per-hop progress guarantee); a pathological huge ladder value could overflow the i32 dist sums in the Dijkstra. The shipped ladder 20/10/5 is safe; magnitude caps on balance data are a pre-existing pattern (capacity_units etc. are unbounded too) — ride with the playtest/balance gate, not this canon job.
detail: Catalog load validates only `cost >= 1`; a ladder value near i32::MAX passes load and can overflow `dist[cur] + cost` in the Dijkstra. Documented and deferred in deferred-work.md — note-level, not a blocker.
recommended_fix: Add the deferred upper-bound check (e.g. `cost <= 1e6`) to the pipe_tiers load validation block when the playtest/balance gate lands.
